messages:
Anika: heads up 1 opened a migration docs PR for the structured audit event v2 schema (rename event_type -> schema_type, add optional retention_label). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/734
Rahul: great. important: legal prefers we avoid implying we control regulatory retention. suggested phrasing: 'retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law.'
Megan: from eng side: note that older ingest clients will still accept event_type but will log a deprecation warning. we'll include a short compatibility example and a one-liner about deprecation timeline (90 days).
Anika: planning to add a migration snippet showing old vs new event fields plus an SDK example that sets retention_label. sketch below:

```# JS SDK (new)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.audit.ingest({
  tenant_id: 'acct-42',
  schema_type: 'user_login',
  payload: { user_id: 'u-123' },
  retention_label: 'security:365d'
})
```

```
# Older client (legacy)
await client.audit.ingest({ tenant_id: 'acct-42', event_type: 'user_login', payload: { user_id: 'u-123' } })
```
Rahul: legal asks to add a cross-ref to the SOC2 FAQ and a short caveat: 'exports or retention may be affected by legal holds or regulatory obligations.' also, don't promise exact deletion dates.
Megan: also adding a tiny note in the SDK docs: if you set an unknown retention_label the server will reject the event unless tenant is in permissive-mode. linking to the API error codes page.
Anika: added Rahul's phrasing and the SOC2 FAQ link. trimmed implementation details per legal (no infra names). added a deprecation paragraph and a 90-day window example.
docs-bot: Preview deployment available: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/734/structured-audit-v2-migration 680 (expires in 7 days)
Rahul: can we include a brief troubleshooting bullet: if ingest returns 422 check that `schema_type` is valid and that `retention_label` matches tenant policy. also recommend a simple curl test command.
Anika: added troubleshooting + curl snippet. curl example below:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/ingest
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct-42","schema_type":"user_login","payload":{"user_id":"u-123"},"retention_label":"security:365d"}'
```
Megan: LGTM from eng. we'll run the new example through the SDK CI smoke test before merge.
Rahul: +1 pending final legal quick-pass. thanks for adding the SOC2 cross-ref and caveat.
Anika: thanks all 44d merging after the legal sign-off and CI snippet smoke test passes.
